title: Gale-Robinson Quivers and Principal Coefficients
summary: In this paper, we provide a combinatorial interpretation for Laurent polynomials obtained by iteratively mutating a certain periodic quiver that has been framed with frozen vertices. This yields a family of cluster variables with principal coefficients associated to a family of integer sequences known as Gale-Robinson sequences. The work of this paper completes arguments for preliminary results announced in earlier work of Jeong-Musiker-Zhang, and relates to works of Bousquet-Mélou-Propp-West, Speyer, Vichitkunakorn, and of Eager-Franco.
